neighborhoods.name: Saltaire
neighborhoods.notes: UNESCO model village with listed buildings and conservation area

property_mix.era: predominantly pre-1945, concentrated Victorian and Edwardian
property_mix.notable: Saltaire UNESCO heritage status drives conservation-grade locks; dense terraced stock typical of West Yorkshire mill towns

locksmith_relevant: Saltaire's listed status means many properties require period-appropriate locks and specialist heritage hardware fitting.
Steep Nab Wood and Windhill areas have older stone properties with worn frames; traditional mortice locks are common and often need rekeying.
High Victorian terrace density across neighborhoods increases demand for multi-property management and landlord master-key systems.
